day_shape: 72 items: Trump says further Iran strikes 'highly unlikely' if talks progress while Israel reportedly braced for weekend strike, four explosions reported on Qeshm, Iran's navy claims tanker hit mine near Hormuz, two OFAC sanctions notices posted, heavy IRIB/Defa Press domestic cycle.

threads.label: Trump-Iran talks and threatened strikes
threads.summary: Trump told reporters further US strikes on Iran are 'highly unlikely' if indirect negotiations progress, while Jerusalem Post sources said Israel braced for a US strike over the weekend that Trump held off. Iran International reported Tehran signalled readiness for talks conditional on Washington lifting post-Islamabad measures, and Rubio called some Iranian conditions 'outrageous.'

threads.label: Hormuz incidents and oil-sanctions enforcement
threads.summary: Iran's navy said an oil tanker caught fire after striking a naval mine east of the Strait of Hormuz, and four explosions were reported on Qeshm Island on Sunday evening. Iran International reported Iran is using oil terminals in China to keep sanctioned tankers running, and said the new US 'Iron Gate' task force is targeting northern overland routes; OFAC published two SDN/sanctions notices.

threads.label: IDF West Bank and Lebanon operations
threads.summary: The IDF said troops apprehended 10 Palestinian Islamic Jihad-affiliated suspects in a Paratroopers and Duvdevan raid on Arraba, and announced the 98th Division completed its Judea and Samaria mission after 1,500+ counterterrorism operations. In southern Lebanon, the IDF said forces located two weapons stockpiles in Meiss El Jabal within 100–200m of UN posts.

threads.label: Iran-linked cyber threats against Tel Aviv
threads.summary: Israeli police and Shin Bet said they are investigating flyers with QR codes linking to threatening content found in northern Tel Aviv mailboxes, attributed to an Iran-linked hacker group. Defa Press and IRIB said the Hanzala group warned it would target Tel Aviv power plants, refineries and desalination facilities if 'resistance' energy infrastructure is attacked.

threads.label: Regime messaging on deterrence and US
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that US military bases 'cannot even provide for their own security,' while Defa Press carried a spokesman saying Armed Forces strategy has shifted to an 'offensive approach' without geographical restrictions. Defa Press commentators said Washington is trying to persuade Iran via Russia and China, and framed Republican midterm losses as a post-Trump pivot by JD Vance.

threads.label: Yemen, Saudi Arabia and Syrian forces
threads.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said it destroyed a Houthi ballistic missile launch platform in Sanaa used in an attempted attack on Saudi Arabia. Jerusalem Post reports and analysis said Syria is sending forces to Saudi Arabia with unclear numbers and purpose, and questioned whether foreign troops could address Yemeni force command problems.

threads.label: Iran domestic: energy, weather, dissent
threads.summary: IRIB carried Oil Ministry appeals as winter gas consumption rose 60–70 million cubic metres, alongside flooding that Iran International said killed four and cut off 190 villages. Iran International also reported two Tehran bookstores were sealed after a Halloween crackdown, and said a 17-year-old killed in January had been tortured by security forces at age 13.

events.summary_en: The Mahan scheme: simultaneous savings in gas and electricity/Yazd pilot successful. Babai, Governor of Yazd: Last year we achieved 40,000 cubic metres and in the first six months of this year 10,000 cubic metres of gas savings. The Gas Company confirmed that 800 billion tomans has been allocated to this scheme and 40,000 households have entered it; each household receives 20 million tomans. The Mahan scheme in Yazd was piloted and successful and will, God willing, be implemented across the country.

events.summary_en: Death toll from Gaza war reaches 74,643. events.title_en: 25 percent increase in medicine foreign currency supply compared to last year
events.summary_en: 25 percent increase in medicine foreign currency supply compared to last year. The Central Bank announced: the supply of foreign currency for medicines and medical equipment from the start of the year to 17 Aban 1405 reached 3 billion 574 million dollars with 25 percent growth (corresponding period last year: 2 billion 868 million dollars). Of the 1,500 trillion rials in facilities allocated for companies introduced by the Food and Drug Organisation, 1,530 trillion rials have been paid by 17 Aban. The ceiling for facilities and commitments of pharmaceutical companies, medical equipment, infant formula and special foods increased from 90 percent to 150 percent of previous year's sales and the credit ceiling for facilities and commitments in general rose to 30 percent of banks' base capital.

events.title: 88 years ago today, on what would become known as Kristallnacht, the Nazis set fire to over 1,400 synagogues, looted and destroyed thousands of Jewish owned businesses and homes. That night, they attacked and murdered Jewish people across Germany. Almost 26,000 Jewish men were arrested and sent to concentration camps. The world watched in silence as Jewish lives were shattered and their humanity was denied. No army came to protect them. Today, the Jewish people aren’t defenseless anymore. The IDF is there to protect Israel and its people, determined to eliminate any threat.
